name: ab_perfect_mul_abundant_pos
statement: (n k : ℕ) (hn : Nat.Perfect n) (hk : 0 < k) : Nat.Abundant (k * n)
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (hn : Nat.Perfect n) (hk : 0 < k), Nat.Abundant (k * n)
informal: Task 3(a) literally with N = positive integers. FALSE at k = 1, as the paper notes.
original: If n is perfect, then kn is abundant for any k ∈ N.
